result.summary: Extends the `CheckTxInputs` unit test helper to accept transactions with multiple inputs. Adds a test case where individual inputs are within valid money ranges but their sum exceeds `MAX_MONEY`. This ensures test coverage for checking cumulative input values when verifying transactions against consensus rules.
result.problem: Existing `CheckTxInputs` unit tests only exercised single-input transactions, so cumulative input value `nValueIn` was always equal to individual coin value `coin.out.nValue`. Consequently, a consensus regression or mutant changing the condition `!MoneyRange(coin.out.nValue) || !MoneyRange(nValueIn)` to use logical AND would pass unnoticed.
evidence: PR description highlights a surviving mutant (mutanthub #275) in `src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp` where `||` was replaced with `&&` without failing existing unit tests
result.scope_notes: Small test-only change modifying a test helper and adding a single invalid transaction test case.
result.card: This PR updates the CheckTxInputs unit tests to cover transactions with multiple inputs whose cumulative value exceeds MAX_MONEY even though each individual input is valid. Previously, the test suite only checked single-input transactions, leaving a mutation that replaced a logical OR with AND alive in Consensus::CheckTxInputs. The PR has no external dependencies.

risk.why: The patch only modifies test code and cannot affect production consensus validation.
